headline: 24 contracts catalogued across Base; 13 protocol-core and 11 supporting/fee contracts from two distinct deployments

findings.text: Block-explorer search on BaseScan revealed 8 named contracts tagged as Aerodrome SlipStream components; additional related contracts discovered via GitHub mapping
GitHub aerodrome-finance/slipstream README.md lists 24 deployed contract addresses across Initial Deployment and Gauge Caps Deployment phases with explicit roles
No formal audit reports linked in protocol.audit_links; stakeliquid.com reports audits by 'several reputable firms' (details not publicly disclosed); DeFiLlama displays 'Audits: No'
GitHub repository aerodrome-finance/slipstream confirmed; main branch contains deployment scripts and contract source code; no testnet artifacts discovered
Single chain deployment (Base); all 24 addresses reside on Base mainnet; no cross-chain variants identified

PoolFactory (0x5e7BB104d84c7CB9B682AaC2F3d509f5F406809A initial; 0xaDe65c38CD4849aDBA595a4323a8C7DdfE89716a caps-deployment) is designated factory; pool enumeration not attempted (in-scope factory but no child cap imposed by D6 protocol)
Roles assigned: factory, router, quoter, gauge, position_manager, fee_module, redistributor per GitHub README and BaseScan labels
All 24 addresses trace to fetched GitHub README and verified BaseScan label pages; no snippet-only sightings included

rationale.verdict: Catalogued 24 Slipstream protocol contracts from two GitHub-listed deployment phases (Initial and Gauge Caps) on Base mainnet via BaseScan block-explorer labels and GitHub repository README. Core protocol addresses (factories, routers, quoters, gauges, position managers) plus supporting fee-module infrastructure identified. No cross-chain deployments; all addresses on Base.

protocol_metadata.about: Aerodrome Slipstream is a concentrated liquidity AMM (CLMM) deployed on Base blockchain, launched in March 2024 to complement the base Aerodrome V1 protocol. It enables efficient capital deployment through Uniswap V3-like concentrated liquidity mechanisms, allowing liquidity providers to concentrate capital in chosen price ranges and earn swap fees on high-volume trading pairs. The protocol integrates with Aerodrome's veNFT governance model, distributing protocol revenue to governance token holders and supporting dynamic fee structures.
